designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of the Interior designated Baker Island and its surrounding waters as a national wildlife refuge.

authority.citation: Secretary of the Interior designation, June 27, 1974 (Reorganization Plan No. 3)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Baker Island National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Baker Island National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan [Final] (ServCat 1382): "the Secretary of the Interior, on June 27, 1974, designated Baker Island and its territorial sea ... as a unit of the National Wildlife Refuge System"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Baker Island National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1974 and lies just north of the equator in the central Pacific Ocean and about 1,830 nautical miles southwest of Honolulu.
